rows.text: Zada turns one spell into twenty. Any instant or sorcery that targets ONLY Zada is copied once for every other creature you control, each copy targeting a different one. So a one-mana cantrip with twenty creatures out draws twenty cards, and a two-mana pump spell pumps the whole army. The main engine is cheap spells that target your own creature, and Goblins to copy them onto. Recruiter into Ringleader or Muxus is the backup when Zada cannot stick. Muxus is a six-mana setup payoff; keep the cheap bodies, cantrips and rituals for the normal Zada plan.

Two rules matter. Copies are not CAST: Storm-Kiln Artist triggers on copies, but Young Pyromancer, Birgi, Electro and Runaway Steam-Kin only see the original spell. And Zada must be targetable by you — Swiftfoot Boots is fine, because hexproof only stops opponents, but never give Zada shroud.

rows.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
rows.text: four mana. Cast a spell that targets only Zada and it is copied for each other creature you control. Cast your creatures first, then the spells.

rows.name: Swiftfoot Boots
rows.text: haste and hexproof for Zada — opponents can't target it, you still can.

rows.name: Hexing Squelcher
rows.text: your spells can't be countered, so the spell Zada copies resolves — though removing Zada in response still fizzles it.

guide.title: The engine — one spell, every creature

rows.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder + Expedite
rows.text: one red mana: every creature gains haste and you draw a card per creature. Crimson Wisps, Impolite Entrance, Might of the Meek, Renegade Tactics, Ancestral Anger and Accelerate do the same draw.

rows.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder + Storm-Kiln Artist + Reckless Ransacking
rows.text: each copy makes a Treasure, and Storm-Kiln makes another for the cast and for every copy — about two Treasures per creature for two mana, and the whole team gets +3/+2. Sudden Breakthrough and Ancestors' Aid do the same with first strike.

rows.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder + Fists of Flame
rows.text: cast it after a cantrip turn. Each copy draws first, then gives its creature +1/+0 for every card drawn so far this turn, plus trample — after twenty draws each creature gets +21/+0 or more.

rows.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder + Haste Magic
rows.text: every creature gets +3/+1 and haste, and each copy exiles a card you can play until your next end step.

rows.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder + Twinflame
rows.text: two mana: a hasty copy of every creature you control. With Impact Tremors or General Kreat out, each copy entering is damage to each opponent. Molten Duplication does the same. Copies of legendary creatures still enter and trigger your payoffs, but you keep only one of each name.

rows.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder + Temur Battle Rage
rows.text: the finisher: double strike for the whole army, plus trample if anything has 4 power.

rows.name: Frontline Heroism
rows.text: whenever you cast a spell that targets one of your creatures, a hasty 1/1 and a copy of the spell for it. Resolve its trigger before Zada's, so the new Soldier gets a Zada copy too.

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame
rows.text: cast Twinflame on any creature you control in your main phase, then flash Dualcaster in with Twinflame still on the stack. Dualcaster copies Twinflame onto itself; the hasty token copies it again; repeat. Unlimited hasty 2/2s. Molten Duplication also works when its token copies Dualcaster.

rows.name: Grinning Ignus + Birgi, God of Storytelling
rows.text: {R} returns Ignus to your hand for {C}{C}{R}; recast it for that; Birgi refunds {R}. Unlimited casts and enters at sorcery speed — damage with Impact Tremors or General Kreat. Ruby Medallion makes every lap a mana richer.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Zealous Conscripts
rows.text: Kiki copies Conscripts and the copy untaps Kiki — target Kiki itself. Unlimited hasty 3/3s.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Lightning Crafter + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: Kiki copies the Crafter; the copy champions Kiki, taps for 3 damage, and is sacrificed; Kiki returns untapped with haste. Unlimited 3-damage shots; Skirk Prospector works as the outlet too. When the original Crafter enters you must exile another Goblin or Shaman (champion) or sacrifice it.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Conspicuous Snoop
rows.text: Recruiter puts Kiki on top of your library, and Snoop copies itself with Kiki's ability, every copy hasty. Snoop needs haste or a turn first; all but the last copy end up tapped, so finish with Impact Tremors, General Kreat or Goblin Bombardment.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: when you already hold Zealous Conscripts or Lightning Crafter.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Goblin Recruiter
rows.text: when you need two or more pieces — Recruiter stacks them.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: when you need bodies for Zada to copy onto.

rows.name: Imperial Recruiter -> Storm-Kiln Artist
rows.text: power 2: the Treasure engine — or Dualcaster Mage when you hold a copy spell, Kiki-Jiki, Conspicuous Snoop or Young Pyromancer.

rows.name: Gamble -> Twinflame
rows.text: any card: Twinflame when Dualcaster is in hand, Storm-Kiln Artist when you have spells but no mana, Underworld Breach for a big turn. Cast it with few cards in hand.

rows.name: Underworld Breach -> Expedite
rows.text: escape cantrips from your graveyard by exiling three other cards each time. Not infinite, and Breach is sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step, but with Zada and Storm-Kiln each recast that turn is a pile of cards and Treasures.

rows.name: Past in Flames
rows.text: every instant and sorcery in your graveyard can be cast again this turn — a second Zada turn in one card.

rows.name: Pinnacle Monk
rows.text: returns an instant or sorcery to your hand, or plays as a land.

guide.title: Goblin Recruiter setups — what to stack, top card first

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: TOP to BOTTOM: Goblin Ringleader; Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker; Lightning Crafter; Skirk Prospector; Hexing Squelcher. Draw or otherwise reach Ringleader, then cast it: its entry trigger puts the next four selected Goblins into your hand. Those creatures still need to be cast; Ringleader does not deploy them. If Ringleader is already in hand, start the pile with the four targets instead.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: TOP to BOTTOM: Muxus, Goblin Grandee; Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker; Lightning Crafter; Skirk Prospector; Hexing Squelcher; Goblin Ringleader; Krenko, Mob Boss. Reach and cast Muxus; all six following cards are Goblin creatures with mana value five or less, so its entry trigger puts them onto the battlefield. If Muxus is already in hand, omit it from the pile and reveal the six immediately.

rows.name: Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: Put these four cards immediately UNDER the six-card Muxus package: Goblin Matron; General Kreat, the Boltbringer; Conspicuous Snoop; Goblin Instigator. When Muxus deploys Ringleader, the entry trigger puts this backup package into your hand. Resolve Ringleader before any other draw triggers and before the original Lightning Crafter's champion trigger. Only stack cards still in your library; substitute useful Goblins for pieces already in hand or on the battlefield.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Lightning Crafter + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: The original Crafter champions the Recruiter that made the pile, or the Ringleader AFTER its refill resolves. Keep Kiki and Prospector on the battlefield. Tap Kiki to copy Crafter; the hasty copy champions Kiki, taps for 3 damage, then is sacrificed to Prospector for {R}. Kiki returns untapped with haste. Repeat for lethal damage and red mana. No combat or commander is required, but removal or effects that stop the entry triggers/activated abilities can interrupt it.

rows.name: Hexing Squelcher
rows.text: The Muxus pile supplies ward for the other creatures and makes later spells uncounterable. Entering with Muxus does not protect the Muxus spell retroactively; when you need that protection, cast Squelcher before Muxus.

Conspicuous Snoop can cast the top Goblin payoff directly. A Zada cantrip normally draws several cards: account for every copy, putting spare cards above the payoff so the payoff is the LAST card drawn and the package stays below it. The next natural draw or casting through Snoop is simpler.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: The existing Snoop line remains: with Conspicuous Snoop able to tap and a damage/sacrifice payoff available, leave Kiki on top to grant Snoop the copy ability. Choose this pile instead of the Muxus/Ringleader pile when Snoop already has the win.

Searches that shuffle undo the pile: use fetch lands and other tutors BEFORE Recruiter. Any extra draw, mill or exile also changes the positions; account for it before committing. Muxus only puts eligible Goblin CREATURES onto the battlefield: Goblin-typed instants/enchantments and Muxus itself are not hits. Recruiter does not put the payoff in your hand for free.

guide.title: Bodies for Zada to copy onto

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: taps for a Goblin per Goblin — twice as many copies next spell.

rows.name: Young Pyromancer
rows.text: an Elemental for every instant or sorcery you cast.

rows.name: Goblin Instigator
rows.text: two bodies for two.

rows.name: Mogg War Marshal
rows.text: a Goblin now and another when it dies.

rows.name: Rally at the Hornburg
rows.text: two 1/1 Soldiers for two mana.

rows.name: Hordeling Outburst
rows.text: three Goblins.

rows.name: Empty the Warrens
rows.text: two Goblins, plus two more for each spell cast before it this turn. Zada's copies aren't cast, so only real spells count.

rows.name: Kher Keep
rows.text: a land that makes 0/1 Kobolds — every one is another copy.

rows.name: Urza's Saga
rows.text: makes Construct tokens, then fetches Sol Ring, Lotus Petal, Mox Amber or Skullclamp.

rows.name: Impact Tremors
rows.text: 1 to each opponent for every creature that enters under your control — Twinflame on Zada becomes a sweeper on their life totals.

rows.name: General Kreat, the Boltbringer
rows.text: 1 to each opponent for every OTHER creature entering under your control, plus a Goblin when your Goblins attack.

rows.name: Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: sacrifice a creature for 1 damage.

rows.name: Mox Amber
rows.text: free; taps for red once Zada, Birgi, Krenko or Electro is out.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: the fastest start.

rows.name: Lotus Petal
rows.text: free mana.

rows.name: Simian Spirit Guide
rows.text: exile it for {R}.

rows.name: Ruby Medallion
rows.text: red spells cost {1} less — generic mana only, so a one-mana {R} spell still costs {R}.

rows.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling
rows.text: {R} for every spell you cast, and it doesn't empty between phases.

rows.name: Electro, Assaulting Battery
rows.text: {R} for every instant or sorcery you cast, and you keep unspent red mana between steps and phases.

rows.name: Runaway Steam-Kin
rows.text: grows with red spells, then cashes three counters in for {R}{R}{R}.

rows.name: Skirk Prospector
rows.text: sacrifice a Goblin for {R}.

rows.name: Brightstone Ritual
rows.text: a red mana for every Goblin on the battlefield.

rows.name: Battle Hymn
rows.text: a red mana for every creature you control.

rows.name: Jeska's Will
rows.text: with Zada out, both halves: red mana per card in an opponent's hand and the top three cards to play.

rows.name: Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer
rows.text: a Treasure and a stolen card every time it connects.

rows.name: Three Tree City
rows.text: name Goblin: {2} and a tap make a red mana per Goblin.

rows.name: Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx
rows.text: mono-red devotion into a pile of red mana.

rows.name: Reliquary Tower
rows.text: no maximum hand size — you will draw twenty cards.

rows.name: Rite of Flame
rows.text: one mana for {R}{R} — the cheapest way to start a big turn.

rows.name: Skullclamp
rows.text: equip it to a 1/1 and when it dies you draw two.

rows.name: Valakut Awakening
rows.text: a land, or a new hand.

rows.name: Defense Grid
rows.text: every spell costs {3} more except on its caster's turn, so answering Zada on your turn costs opponents three extra. They can still pay, and activated abilities aren't taxed. Your own Pyroblast and Deflecting Swat cost more on their turns too.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free with Zada out; redirect the removal aimed at it — or the counterspell aimed at your big spell.

rows.name: Untimely Malfunction
rows.text: change the target of a single-target spell or ability — the removal pointed at Zada mid-turn.

rows.name: Pyroblast
rows.text: one mana against the blue answer.

rows.name: Red Elemental Blast
rows.text: the second copy.

rows.name: Chaos Warp
rows.text: the red answer to anything.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep mana, two or three creatures and a cheap spell. Zada on turn three or four with four bodies out already draws four off one Expedite.
Build the board first, then spend the turn: a Treasure spell to make mana, cantrips to draw, Twinflame or a pump to finish.

Nothing here stops a sweeper that doesn't target. Equip Swiftfoot Boots before the big turn (equipping is sorcery speed), keep Deflecting Swat or Untimely Malfunction for targeted removal, and after a wipe rebuild with Kher Keep and the token spells.
